actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

official_title: To amend title 38, United States Code, to establish decision clocks for certain veterans' disability claims and administrative appeals, to strengthen accountability for claims adjudication, to improve clinical performance pay, to require benefits-system records interoperability and public reporting, and for other purposes.
short_title: Veterans Claims Timeliness, Accountability, and Care Act

titles.title: Veterans Claims Timeliness, Accountability, and Care Act
Veterans Claims Timeliness, Accountability, and Care Act

To amend title 38, United States Code, to establish decision clocks for certain veterans' disability claims and administrative appeals, to strengthen accountability for claims adjudication, to improve clinical performance pay, to require benefits-system records interoperability and public reporting, and for other purposes.
